`reconcile_e2e()` computes the union of measured terminal intervals inside the
outer interval. Overlapping client, model, tool, and setup spans count once.
The complement is emitted as one or more `unknown_residual` intervals with
their actual monotonic boundaries; no residual is placed at a fabricated
contiguous offset and no broad wrapper is counted as improved phase coverage.

sources.source_excerpt: | D9 hardware-parameterized event simulator | Reusable workload trace with event identities, dependency order and pre-feature/observed-work separation; all event timing labels; hardware measurements/assumptions | Calibrate event models, predict each event and E2E, regenerate every Step-1–3 figure, test <=25% for every individual event and E2E | Fit/select only permitted calibration data; freeze before final labels; failures/unsupported events counted honestly; no fitted residual concealing missing phases |

Before launch freeze the final inventory, model/agent/vLLM pins, all effective settings, schema, actual source bundle, evaluator, measured hardware profile, run manifest and retry policy. Preserve attempts and export raw artifacts durably before advancing resume state. After completion audit all 1,088 cases, generate D1–D8 and all observed/predicted figures, fit/select D9 with a sealed instance-level calibration/evaluation boundary, and perform the literal PDF compliance audit. A D9 model failure triggers diagnosis/model work on collected evidence, not another automatic full data-collection run.

rules.observed_enforcement_at_audit: Averages cannot establish every-event compliance. Historical D9 failure is not by itself proof that another data acquisition run must be blocked; FINAL_RUN_DESIGN says diagnose/model collected evidence without automatic full recollection.
rules.still_blocks: Only a concrete unrecoverable/invalid acquisition deficiency under A24; postcollection checks do not block acquisition.
